reviewAuthority: Independent interoperability reviewer(s) to be assigned
exitCriteria: Review is performed against the frozen candidate baseline.
Interoperability claims are supported by identifiable implementations and reproducible evidence.
Any blocking finding has an accepted disposition and verification evidence.
Reviewer attestation and evidence references are recorded.

decisionAuthority.scope: Disposition findings, accept remediation or risk, and determine release impact under GOVERNANCE.md.
